vulnerable_code:
class ExportUserDataWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(target_user_id, destination_email)
    # Worker blindly trusts payload parameters without verifying requester authorization
    user = User.find(target_user_id)
    archive = Privacy::DataCompiler.new(user).build_zip

    UserMailer.data_export_ready(user, destination_email, archive).deliver_now
  end
end

class PrivacyController < ApplicationController
  def export
    ExportUserDataWorker.perform_async(params[:target_user_id], params[:destination_email])
    render json: { status: 'Export queued' }, status: :accepted
  end
end
diagnosis: The background worker exports full account data for target_user_id and emails the generated archive to destination_email without validating whether the initiating user has permission to export that account. An attacker can enqueue exports for victim user IDs and dispatch their entire private data archive to an attacker-controlled inbox.

corrected_code:
class ExportUserDataWorker
  include Sidekiq::Worker

  def perform(requester_id, target_user_id, destination_email)
    requester = User.find(requester_id)
    user = User.find(target_user_id)

    raise 'Unauthorized export' unless requester.id == user.id || requester.admin?

    archive = Privacy::DataCompiler.new(user).build_zip
    UserMailer.data_export_ready(user, destination_email, archive).deliver_now
  end
end

class PrivacyController < ApplicationController
  def export
    ExportUserDataWorker.perform_async(current_user.id, current_user.id, current_user.email)
    render json: { status: 'Export queued' }, status: :accepted
  end
end
